description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families across three model types: mBERT, XLM-R, and “same”. The horizontal axis displays language family categories—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “task count”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each language family, there are three adjacent bars representing the task count for each model type. The “same” model is represented by a light green bar, XLM-R by a medium green bar, and mBERT by a dark blue bar. For IE-Baltic, the “same” model has a task count of approximately 12, XLM-R has a task count of approximately 22, and mBERT has a task count of approximately 24. The tallest bar is for mBERT in the IE-Slavic category, with a task count of 36, while the shortest bar is for the “same” model in the Uralic category, with a task count of approximately 6. The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing one bar for each model type. No bars are visually emphasized.
